title: Gift Wrapper

fields.label: function
fields.value: Turns items and structures into openable gift items.

body:
"A special tool that lets you gift any item or structure into a present!"

Description

The Gift Wrapper is an exclusive 2025 Christmas Event tool that behaves very similarly to the Material Gun. It does nothing without at least one of the four Wrapping Paper materials available at Santa's Workshop for ❄️99 each.

Once you have a Wrapping Paper purchased, you can equip the Gift Wrapper and click it (there should be a highlight around it) to consume the paper. It will now be in the wrapper, allowing you to select the wrapping paper in the menu. Then, once a paper is selected, you can click on an item or structure to turn it into a boxed gift with the chosen wrapping paper texture, consuming the wrapping paper one time.

Wrapped Gift

Once an object or structure has been wrapped, it turns into a Wrapped Gift of a loosely similar size and shape. It will have the same wrapping paper texture as the one used to wrap it. These objects can then be stored or unboxed when held for 0.5 seconds, allowing for easier mobility and storage of some objects and structures. (Trading isn't recommended as the contents of the gift are never displayed, to allow for surprise gifts.)

"A special present, just for you!"
